title: Allotment Watering Roster System
originalRequest: Design and implement a roster scheduling and telemetry tracking application for community allotment watering management.
latestMessage: Design and implement a roster scheduling and telemetry tracking application for community allotment watering management.

steps.title: Define database schema for plots and crops
steps.instruction: Create a relational schema to store allotment plots, assigned gardeners, and crop types with their daily water volume requirements.
steps.acceptance: Schema SQL script compiles and executes without errors on the target database, establishing foreign key constraints between plots and crop types.
steps.result: First attempt failed due to a syntax error in the foreign key constraint definition for the crop types table. On the second attempt, corrected the table creation order and successfully initialized the schema. Verification queries confirm tables are active and indexed correctly.

steps.title: Seed initial crop water requirements data
steps.instruction: Populate the crop reference table with standardized baseline water volumes (liters per square meter) for key crop types.
steps.acceptance: The crop reference table contains at least 10 standard crop types with non-null daily watering coefficients.
steps.result: The initial import script failed on the first run due to mismatched CSV delimiters in the seed file. Regenerated the import script using correct comma-separated formatting and successfully populated the reference database with 12 crop profiles on the second run.

steps.title: Implement roster scheduling calculation logic
steps.instruction: Develop a backend service to generate a weekly watering schedule, distributing duties evenly among available gardeners while prioritizing plots with high-consumption crops.
steps.acceptance: Function outputs a 7-day JSON matrix mapping gardener IDs to plot IDs, ensuring no gardener is assigned back-to-back days unless necessary.
steps.result: Successfully implemented the scheduling algorithm using a greedy distribution approach. Tests confirm even distribution of assignments and prioritization of high-demand zones. Output format conforms to the specified JSON schema.

steps.title: Integrate local weather API feed
steps.instruction: Connect the scheduling module to a local meteorological API to dynamically reduce scheduled water volumes on days with forecasted rainfall. [BLOCKED] This task is blocked because the public API endpoint registration is pending administrative approval for the API key.
steps.acceptance: Algorithm decreases target watering volume by 50% if rainfall > 2mm is forecasted within 12 hours of the scheduled time.

steps.title: Build gardener notification dispatch service
steps.instruction: Develop the automated worker service that dispatches daily SMS notifications to the scheduled gardeners. [BLOCKED] Blocked pending final selection and procurement of the SMS gateway provider by the project sponsor.
steps.acceptance: Outbound queue processor successfully formats and sends message payloads to the SMS gateway API.

steps.title: Implement flow-meter telemetry intake
steps.instruction: Write an ingestion service to parse IoT flow-meter pulse readings and record actual water applied per plot. [BLOCKED] Blocked by lack of hardware specification sheets for the newly ordered flow-meter units.
steps.acceptance: System processes raw pulse count inputs and converts them to liters with +/- 2% accuracy.

steps.title: Develop historical water-usage reporting dashboard
steps.instruction: Create a web interface summarizing monthly water consumption vs. roster schedules to optimize overall garden resource usage.
steps.acceptance: Dashboard displays interactive charts comparing scheduled water targets against telemetry-recorded actuals.
